auditor_value: (a) t = 2 s for both; (b) h = ½gt² = 19.6 m with g = 9.8 (20 m with g = 10); (c) 15 m from the bank

findings.quote: Taking the horizontal distance s = 10 m itself as the fall height instead of computing it from the time of flight gives 10 m, well short of the correct 19.6 m.
findings.note: Not a genuine error for this question: no student confuses the stated horizontal landing distance with the bank height. The real slips here are dropping the ½ in h = ½gt² or treating the vertical motion as uniform.
findings.fix: Leaving out the ½ in h = ½gt² gives h = 9.8 × 2² = 39.2 m, twice the correct 19.6 m.

notes: The question gives no value of g; the solution's g = 9.8 m/s² is an acceptable choice (h = 20 m with g = 10 m/s²).
